name: Splithoof Heights
summary: Splithoof Heights refers to the elevated mesas bordering the northern cliffs of Thousand Needles, overlooking the jagged riverbed canyons below. The heights are heavily frequented by the ferocious Galak centaur, whose warbands roam the cliffs between their strongholds at Splithoof Hold and Splithoof Crag. Travelers passing through the needles must constantly watch the high ridges for charging centaur raiding parties.

sections.title: Territory of the Galak
sections.body: Rising along the sheer canyon walls of northern Thousand Needles, these lofty plateaus sit above the arid canyon floor. The area serves as elevated roaming grounds for the brutal Galak tribe of centaur, who use the commanding terrain to keep watch over the surrounding trails. From these ridges, sentries maintain sightlines linking strongholds such as Splithoof Hold, Splithoof Crag, and Camp E'thok, making any trespass into the northern cliffs extremely dangerous for travelers.

sections.title: A Hostile Watchpost
sections.body: The Galak tribe has contested the canyon reaches of Thousand Needles for generations, fiercely defying the tauren of Freewind Post and raiding anyone entering the region. The heights provide them with natural defensive bastions, sheltered from the flash floods and dust storms of the valley floor. Anyone journeying beneath the bluffs should keep their eyes turned upward, as Galak scouts rarely hesitate to descend upon the unprepared.

faq.answer: The heights are dominated by the Galak centaur, a belligerent tribe native to Thousand Needles. They patrol the rocky plateaus and maintain ties to nearby settlements like Splithoof Hold and Splithoof Crag.

faq.q: Why is this area important to the centaur?
aliases: why are centaur on the heights
faq.answer: The high vantage point allows the Galak tribe to watch the canyon pathways below, safeguarding their strongholds while positioning scouts to spot approaching threats or vulnerable caravans traversing the needles.
Splithoof Heights encompasses the high northern ridges of Thousand Needles, perched directly above the arid canyon floor and near the major Galak centaur fortifications.

angles.text: The Galak tribe has long harassed tauren travelers moving between the Barrens and Freewind Post, making these centaur-held heights an enduring threat to your people.
Controlling the canyon approaches means keeping the Galak centaur on the cliffs from ambushing supply lines and caravans passing through Thousand Needles.
